lead_summary.zh: 301台灣列最低級距；飛彈射向利雅德遭攔截
lead_summary.en: Taiwan in lowest 301 tier; missiles aimed at Riyadh downed

title.zh: 政院：301提案台灣列最低級距　15%不疊加
title.en: Taiwan: 301 proposal puts it in lowest tier, 15% non-stacked

body.zh: 美國貿易代表署公布製造業產能過剩 301 調查報告、擬對 14 個經濟體加徵關稅後，行政院 26 日凌晨發布新聞稿，並由副院長鄭麗君率經濟部長龔明鑫、財政部長莊翠雲等人於上午 8 時 30 分召開記者會說明。政院表示，台灣提議稅率為 15%、不與最惠國稅率疊加，也不再疊加強迫勞動 301 關稅，與日本、南韓、歐盟、瑞士同屬最低級距；報告另列出若諮商未獲美方滿意時的 25% 替代稅率。政院強調這仍是提案，公眾意見收集至 2027 年 1 月 5 日、公聽會 1 月 25 日起舉行，終判前台灣傳產與農產品輸美仍適用 10% 不疊加稅率；經貿工作小組表示將在程序中持續鞏固既有談判成果。
body.en: After the US Trade Representative released its Section 301 report on manufacturing overcapacity proposing tariffs on 14 economies, Taiwan's Executive Yuan issued a statement early on November 26 and Vice Premier Cheng Li-chiun, with Economy Minister Kung Ming-hsin, Finance Minister Chuang Tsui-yun and others, held a briefing at 8:30 a.m. The cabinet said Taiwan's proposed rate is 15%, not stacked on most-favoured-nation duties or the forced-labour 301 tariff, in the lowest tier alongside Japan, South Korea, the EU and Switzerland; the report also lists a 25% alternative rate if Washington is dissatisfied with consultations. The cabinet stressed it is only a proposal, with public comments due by January 5, 2027 and hearings from January 25, and Taiwan's traditional industrial and farm exports keep paying the 10% non-stacked rate until a final decision; the trade working group said it will keep working to lock in the results already negotiated.

title.zh: 聯軍攔截2枚飛彈　胡塞再瞄準利雅德
title.en: Coalition downs two Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh

body.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯主導的聯軍發言人馬爾基 26 日清晨在 X 平台表示，防空系統攔截並摧毀胡塞組織朝首都利雅德發射的 2 枚彈道飛彈；新華社報導市中心可聽到巨大爆炸聲，目前未見傷亡或損害報告。聯軍稱 25 日另擊落一架飛向吉達伊斯蘭港的無人機，並摧毀一枚射向西部地區的巡弋飛彈，吉贊港則遭擊中、受輕微損害但無平民受傷。胡塞組織宣稱攻擊兩座港口是報復聯軍空襲荷台達港，尚未就利雅德飛彈表態。
body.en: Saudi-led coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki said on X early on November 26 that air defences intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis toward Riyadh; Xinhua reported loud explosions in the city centre, with no casualties or damage reported so far. The coalition said that on the 25th it also downed a drone heading for Jeddah Islamic Port and destroyed a cruise missile aimed at the western region, while Jazan Port was hit and slightly damaged with no civilian injuries. The Houthis said the port attacks were retaliation for coalition strikes on Hodeidah port and have not commented on the Riyadh missiles.

title.zh: CNN：美情報機構疑遭駭　初步指向中國
title.en: CNN: US intelligence agencies hit by suspected hack linked to China

body.zh: 美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）引述 4 名消息人士報導，中央情報局（CIA）與國家情報總監辦公室（ODNI）疑似遭駭，受影響的是用於公開來源情報分析、存放非機密資料的系統。ODNI 官員表示關鍵功能與機密系統未受干擾，CIA 拒絕評論；兩名消息人士稱初步跡象指向中國，但尚不清楚是否涉及中國政府，入侵發生時間及是否已修補也未明。
body.en: CNN, citing four sources, reported that the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence appear to have been breached, affecting systems used for open-source intelligence analysis that held unclassified information. An ODNI official said key functions and classified systems were not disrupted and the CIA declined to comment; two sources said early indications point to China, though it is unclear whether the Chinese government was involved, when the breach occurred or whether it has been fixed.

title.zh: 金正恩視察核設施　要求多地部署戰術核武
title.en: Kim inspects nuclear sites, calls for tactical nukes in several areas

body.zh: 北韓官方朝中社 26 日報導，領導人金正恩視察核材料生產與核武研究設施，表示應在多個地區部署戰術核武。據路透報導，金正恩稱北韓正有系統地擴大核材料產能，並強調儘管外界呼籲無核化，北韓的擁核國地位不容談判。報導未說明視察日期。
body.en: North Korea's state news agency KCNA reported on November 26 that leader Kim Jong Un inspected nuclear-material production and weapons research facilities and said tactical nuclear weapons should be deployed in multiple areas. According to Reuters, Kim said Pyongyang is systematically expanding its nuclear-material production capacity and that its status as a nuclear state is not negotiable despite calls for denuclearisation. The report did not give the date of the visit.

title.zh: 伊朗稱兩油輪荷莫茲觸雷　加強管控航道
title.en: Iran says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz, tightens control

body.zh: 伊朗革命衛隊 25 日表示，兩艘油輪在荷莫茲海峽試圖行經「未經授權的航線」時觸及水雷，發生爆炸並起火；伊朗陸軍發言人阿克拉米尼亞表示已部署新系統加強監控這條水道。針對美國的海上封鎖，伊朗副總統阿雷夫稱並不擔心，因經由其他邊境的貨運量已大幅增加；金十數據報導，伊朗副總統也表示政府計畫讓基本民生物資價格至少穩定 3 個月。
body.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on November 25 that two oil tankers struck naval mines, exploded and caught fire while trying to use an "unauthorized route" through the Strait of Hormuz, and army spokesman Mohammad Akraminia said new systems had been deployed to tighten surveillance of the waterway. On the US naval blockade, Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref said Iran was not worried because cargo through other borders had risen sharply; Jin10 reported that he also said the government plans to keep prices of basic goods stable for at least three months.

title.zh: 烏俄擬分批換俘逾千人　俄願續三方會談
title.en: Ukraine, Russia plan phased swap of 1,000+; Moscow open to talks

body.zh: 烏克蘭總統辦公室主任布達諾夫表示，烏俄雙方各逾 1,000 人的換俘將分階段進行，首批預計 11 月底或 12 月初展開，第一階段可望在 12 月 25 日前完成。俄羅斯副外長里亞布科夫表示，莫斯科願意繼續俄美烏三方會談，但下一輪時間未定，並稱俄美將在年底前討論敏感議題。另據路透，俄軍 25 日攻擊敖德薩州造成 2 人死亡。
body.en: Andriy Budanov, head of Ukraine's presidential office, said a swap of more than 1,000 prisoners on each side will take place in phases, with the first batch expected in late November or early December and the first stage due to be completed by December 25. Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov said Moscow is willing to continue trilateral talks with the US and Ukraine, though the next round has not been scheduled, and that Russia and the US will discuss sensitive issues before year-end. Separately, Reuters reported a Russian strike on the Odesa region on the 25th killed two people.

title.zh: 日韓股市開高反彈　日經漲逾800點
title.en: Japan, Korea stocks rebound; Nikkei up more than 800

body.zh: 美股 25 日在感恩節前收復盤中跌幅後，亞股 26 日早盤走高。日經 225 指數以 57,429 點開出、上漲 418 點，盤中一度擴大漲幅至 843 點、報 57,854 點；南韓綜合指數開盤上漲 1.01% 至 4,745.1 點，隨後漲幅擴大至 1.33%。南韓央行同日召開利率會議，市場普遍預期升息 1 碼至 3.25%。
body.en: Asian stocks rose in early trade on November 26 after Wall Street recovered from its intraday slump on the 25th ahead of Thanksgiving. Japan's Nikkei 225 opened up 418 points at 57,429 and extended gains to 843 points at 57,854, while South Korea's KOSPI opened 1.01% higher at 4,745.1 and later rose 1.33%. The Bank of Korea holds a rate meeting the same day, with markets widely expecting a 25-basis-point hike to 3.25%.

title.zh: 標普列輝達負向觀察　盧比歐傳向川普示警
title.en: S&P puts Nvidia on watch; Rubio reportedly warns Trump

body.zh: 彭博報導，標普全球評級對輝達 AA 信用評等展開 90 天評估並列入負向觀察，原因是執行長黃仁勳離職又回任引發治理疑慮，若調降原則上僅限一級。《紐約郵報》則報導，國務卿盧比歐認為黃仁勳與輝達不利美國對中政策，曾向川普示警輝達構成國安威脅；副總統范斯則公開力挺黃仁勳，稱他並未遭調查、也不需要特赦。輝達股價 25 日收跌 3.9% 至 149.30 美元。
body.en: Bloomberg reported that S&P Global Ratings began a 90-day review of Nvidia's AA rating and placed it on negative watch over governance concerns raised by CEO Jensen Huang's departure and return, saying any cut would likely be one notch. The New York Post reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio believes Huang and Nvidia undermine US China policy and has warned Trump the company is a national-security threat, while Vice President JD Vance publicly backed Huang, saying he is not under investigation and needs no pardon. Nvidia shares closed down 3.9% at US$149.30 on the 25th.

title.zh: 中東襲擊不斷　布蘭特原油收漲3.5%
title.en: Middle East attacks lift Brent 3.5% at settle

body.zh: 胡塞組織襲擊沙國港口與煉油設施、伊朗稱油輪在荷莫茲海峽觸雷，使近幾個月逐步恢復的原油運輸前景再蒙陰影。紐約西德州中級原油 1 月期貨 25 日上漲 1.63 美元（1.99%），結算價每桶 83.68 美元；北海布蘭特原油上漲 3.21 美元（3.51%），收每桶 94.61 美元。智通財經另引述數據指出，亞洲買家 12 月採購的美國原油降至約 1,600 萬至 1,800 萬桶，為 2018 年以來最低。
body.en: Houthi attacks on Saudi ports and oil facilities and Iran's report of tankers hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz clouded the outlook for crude shipping, which had been gradually recovering. January WTI rose US$1.63 (1.99%) on November 25 to settle at US$83.68 a barrel, and Brent gained US$3.21 (3.51%) to US$94.61. Zhitong Finance also cited data showing Asian buyers' December purchases of US crude fell to about 16 to 18 million barrels, the lowest since 2018.

title.en: US Q3 GDP revised up to 4.3%; PCE inflation 3.8%

body.zh: 美國經濟分析局 25 日公布，第三季實質 GDP 年化成長率上修 0.9 個百分點至 4.3%，主因投資加速與政府支出回升。10 月 PCE 物價指數月增 0.3%、年增 3.8%，追平 5 月創下的 3 年高點；據金十數據，核心 PCE 年增 3.3%、略高於預期。聯準會同日發布的褐皮書顯示經濟溫和成長、消費支出持平，多數企業回報薪資壓力上升；The Company Chronicle 引述 CME FedWatch 指交易員預期 12 月升息機率達 97%。
body.en: The Bureau of Economic Analysis said on November 25 that third-quarter real GDP growth was revised up 0.9 percentage point to an annualised 4.3%, driven by faster investment and a pickup in government spending. The October PCE price index rose 0.3% on the month and 3.8% on the year, matching May's three-year high; Jin10 said core PCE rose 3.3% year on year, slightly above expectations. The Fed's Beige Book released the same day showed modest growth with flat consumer spending and rising wage pressure reported by firms, and The Company Chronicle, citing CME FedWatch, said traders price a 97% chance of a December hike.

title.zh: 美批准SpaceX百萬顆衛星　建太空資料中心
title.en: US approves 1 million SpaceX satellites for space data centres

body.zh: 美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）25 日表示，已授權 SpaceX 部署名為 Starmind、多達 100 萬顆衛星的星系，用於建置太空資料中心，以支援人工智慧運算需求。依執照條件，SpaceX 須在 2033 年 11 月前開始部署，2035 年 11 月前完成 10%、2038 年 11 月前完成一半；SpaceX 主張衛星幾乎可全天候使用太陽能。中央社指出，目前在軌衛星約 1.7 萬顆，SpaceX 是否真會發射百萬顆仍不明。
body.en: The US Federal Communications Commission said on November 25 it had authorised SpaceX to deploy a constellation of up to 1 million satellites, called Starmind, to build space-based data centres for AI computing demand. Under the licence, SpaceX must begin deployment by November 2033, reach 10% by November 2035 and half by November 2038; SpaceX argues the satellites can run on near-constant solar power. CNA noted that about 17,000 satellites are currently in orbit and it is unclear whether SpaceX will actually launch a million.

headline.zh: 關稅與AI疑慮夾擊　台股重挫1927點
headline.en: TAIEX plunges 1,927 points on tariff and AI worries

body.zh: 加權指數 25 日以 39,983.91 點開出即為全日高點，盤中一度重挫 3,440.45 點至 36,681.90 點，約 10 時 20 分後跌幅收斂，終場下跌 1,926.92 點（4.80%）收 38,195.43 點，為史上第 6 大收盤跌點並跌破年線；成交值放大至 1 兆 1,881.99 億元，上市 39 家上漲、1,053 家下跌、19 家平盤。台積電跌 80 元至 2,150 元，聯發科鎖跌停於 3,645 元，鴻海跌 8.83% 至 206.5 元，台達電跌 2.76% 至 1,055 元，聯電、創意也收跌停，金融股下跌 6.31%。市場受前一日美股費半重挫、美國擬對 14 個經濟體加徵關稅等消息衝擊，外資賣超 1,236.55 億元、自 16 日起連續第 8 個交易日賣超，外資台指期淨空單增至 105,709 口。
body.en: The TAIEX opened at its session high of 39,983.91 on November 25 and plunged as much as 3,440.45 points to 36,681.90 before losses narrowed after about 10:20 a.m., closing down 1,926.92 points (4.80%) at 38,195.43, the sixth-largest point drop on record and below its 240-day moving average; turnover swelled to NT$1.188 trillion, with 39 listed stocks up, 1,053 down and 19 flat. TSMC fell NT$80 to NT$2,150, MediaTek was locked limit-down at NT$3,645, Hon Hai lost 8.83% to NT$206.5 and Delta Electronics 2.76% to NT$1,055, UMC and GUC also closed limit-down, and financials fell 6.31%. The market was hit by the previous day's slump in US chip stocks and the US plan for new tariffs on 14 economies; foreign investors sold a net NT$123.66 billion, their eighth straight day of net selling since the 16th, and raised net short TAIEX futures positions to 105,709 contracts.

flows_note.zh: 投信買超 535.32 億元，是三大法人中唯一買超；外資賣超 1,236.55 億元為最多。
flows_note.en: Investment trusts were the only net buyers at NT$53.53 billion; foreign investors were the largest net sellers at NT$123.66 billion.

headline.zh: 美股：道瓊收復千點跌幅　那指跌0.6%
headline.en: US close, Nov 25: Dow erases 1,100-point drop; Nasdaq off 0.6%

body.zh: 週三（25 日）美國提出新關稅方案、10 月 PCE 顯示通膨未降溫，加上 AI 科技股賣壓，道瓊開盤後一度重挫約 1,105 點、那指盤中跌幅達 4.6%，費半一度下跌約 8%。隨後 AI 股賣壓緩和，經濟日報並指有報導稱美方官員告知國會，沒有證據顯示有中國科技業人士受情報單位指使接近黃仁勳，逢低買盤在感恩節前進場，道瓊終場上漲 164.25 點（0.33%）收 50,182.95 點，標普 500 跌 0.25% 收 7,182.78 點，那指跌 147.73 點（0.62%）收 23,585.80 點，費半跌 0.65% 收 8,774.86 點。個股方面，輝達收跌 3.9%、美光跌約 4.5%，惠普因財報優於預期大漲 11.49%，台積電 ADR 跌 1.96% 收 342.34 美元。台指期夜盤上漲 274 點收 38,397 點；美股 26 日感恩節休市，27 日提前收盤。
body.en: On Wednesday (November 25) a new US tariff proposal, October PCE data showing sticky inflation and selling in AI tech stocks sent the Dow down about 1,105 points shortly after the open, the Nasdaq down as much as 4.6% and the SOX down about 8% intraday. As AI selling eased, helped according to Economic Daily News by a report that US officials told Congress there was no evidence a Chinese tech figure was directed by intelligence services to approach Jensen Huang, bargain hunters stepped in ahead of Thanksgiving: the Dow closed up 164.25 points (0.33%) at 50,182.95, the S&P 500 slipped 0.25% to 7,182.78, the Nasdaq fell 147.73 points (0.62%) to 23,585.80 and the SOX lost 0.65% to 8,774.86. Nvidia closed down 3.9% and Micron about 4.5%, HP jumped 11.49% on better-than-expected results, and the TSMC ADR fell 1.96% to US$342.34. TAIEX futures rose 274 points to 38,397 in the night session; US markets are closed on November 26 for Thanksgiving and close early on the 27th.
